{"id":2029242745,"question_id":3844,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 1 week","timestamp":1781151391,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"758 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2029242745/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Number of Ways to Assign Edge Weights I","memory":"444.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    int mod = 1e9+7;\n\n    unordered_map<int , vector<int>>adj;\n    unordered_map<int , bool>vis;\n\n    int DFS(int node)\n    {\n        vis[node] = true;\n        int maxi = 0;\n\n        for(auto &nbr : adj[node]) \n        {\n            if(!vis[nbr]) maxi = max(maxi , 1 + DFS(nbr));\n        }\n        return maxi;\n    }\n\n    int assignEdgeWeights(vector<vector<int>>& edges) {\n        int n = edges.size()+1;\n\n        for(auto &it : edges) \n        {\n            adj[it[0]].push_back(it[1]);\n            adj[it[1]].push_back(it[0]);\n        }\n        \n        int maxdepth = DFS(1);\n        if(maxdepth == 0) return 1;\n\n        ll ans = 1;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<maxdepth-1 ; i++) ans = (ans * 2) % mod;\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"number-of-ways-to-assign-edge-weights-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2076}
